name: Powerful Connection
body:
Your connection to your patron makes some abilities more potent.

Prerequisites: Patron class feature, Patron Boon which requires a saving throw

Benefits: When you select this feat choose one boon you possess which allows for a saving throw. Increase the saving throw DC of that boon by +1.

Special: You may select this feat multiple times. Each time you do, you must select a different boon which allows for a saving throw.
